title: Trio Life
description: A fan-made lifeseries based off of grian's Last Life
body:
## Idea requested by [@Fleckers42](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCADPU0d6cRZZ9JkEHXB5J2Q)

# Trio Life

Players are randomly assigned into teams of 3.

Each player starts with a random number of lives between 3 and 8.

Your team remains together until the final life stage.

If one member of a team becomes the Boogeyman, the entire team becomes Boogeymen.

Boogeyman teams must secure kills on members of other teams before the session ends.

The objective is to outlast and eliminate every other team.

Final Life Rules

Once all remaining players are on their final life, teams may choose to either:

Stay loyal and continue working together, or

Disband and become free agents.

Players on final life can attack and kill anyone, including former teammates.

Alliances are no longer protected and betrayal is allowed.

Win Condition Be the last player, or last surviving team, standing.

DISCLAIMER: In theory, this datapack will work. But i dont have enough players to test. please feel free to reach out if you are having problems with the datapack at shelleykey.datapacks@gmail.com
